_about: Papers checked in the systematic screening that began on 22 Nov 2026 (method on about.html#selection). Rendered to checked.html by tools/build.py. Outcomes: clean = no error found; nomaterial = no material error found; inprint = already corrected or challenged in print by others; withauthors = finding sent to the authors (count only until they reply or three weeks pass; then add the paper by name, outcome 'flagged', with a link to its register entry); inprogress = check not finished. side: mainstream or questioning (papers questioning mainstream climate findings).
